Common questions

When will you reply?

We do not promise a set time, but every message is read and answered. If you have not heard back and want to move faster, call the main line; the AI receptionist answers at any hour and can take a message marked as a follow-up.

What can I do while I wait?

Call the main line and test the AI receptionist with the questions your own customers ask. Then read the pricing page and the page for your industry, so the first conversation can go straight to the details that matter for your business.

Will you text me?

No. Texting is not live yet on our side: voice works today, and text messages switch on only once carrier approval clears. Even then, sending this form does not sign you up for texts. We reply by email or phone.
